description: Newsvendor optimal order quantity — Single-period inventory decision (perishables, seasonal buys, event stock, print runs). price= and cost= per unit plus demand as mean= (Poisson) or mean= + sd= (normal) or history= past demand list (empirical). Optional salvage= value of leftovers, shortage_penalty= goodwill cost per lost sale, order= to grade your own quantity (NEAR_OPTIMAL/UNDER_ORDERING/OVER_ORDERING). Returns critical ratio, optimal order, safety stock, expected sales/leftover/lost sales, in-stock probability, fill rate, expected profit, value of optimizing vs ordering the mean, expected value of perfect information and a profit sensitivity table. Price: $0.002 USDC (Base, via x402).
